summary: Comprehensive testing of Yuki IDE dev server preview functionality. All backend APIs (13/13 tests passed) and frontend UI flows working correctly. Start/Stop dev server buttons, preview iframe switching between / and localhost:3001, GitHub config modal with cloned repo status all functional.

issues: Missing 'Preview Live' indicator when dev server is running - requirement states there should be a visual indicator but only toast notification is shown

action_items: Add persistent 'Preview Live' indicator in header or preview panel when devServerRunning is true (currently only shows toast notification)
critical_code_review_comments: Yuki.tsx line 160: devServerRunning state is properly managed but no visual indicator is shown in the UI when server is running
github.ts line 184: Dev server start command uses PORT=3001 which is correct for the cloned repo preview
Yuki.tsx line 309: previewUrl is correctly set to localhost:3001 when dev server starts
seed_data_creation: Cloned repo already exists at /app/yuki-repos/chidolol with dependencies installed
context_for_next_testing_agent: All dev server features tested and working: (1) Start button visible when repo cloned and dev server not running, (2) Clicking Start initiates dev server on port 3001, (3) Stop button appears when dev server running, (4) Preview iframe src changes to http://localhost:3001 when started, (5) Preview iframe src reverts to / when stopped, (6) Toast notifications show success messages, (7) GitHub modal shows 'Token configurado' and 'Repo clonado' status. Missing feature: No persistent 'Preview Live' indicator in UI.

features_tested.dev_server_start_api: ✅ Working - POST /api/github/start-dev returns success with previewUrl
features_tested.dev_server_stop_api: ✅ Working - POST /api/github/stop-dev stops server on port 3001
features_tested.dev_server_status_api: ✅ Working - GET /api/github/dev-status returns running state and previewUrl
features_tested.cloned_repo_api: ✅ Working - GET /api/github/cloned-repo shows cloned=true for chidolol
features_tested.start_button_ui: ✅ Working - Play button visible when repo cloned, hidden when server running
features_tested.stop_button_ui: ✅ Working - Square button visible when server running, hidden when stopped
features_tested.preview_iframe_start: ✅ Working - iframe src changes to http://localhost:3001 when dev server starts
features_tested.preview_iframe_stop: ✅ Working - iframe src reverts to / when dev server stops
features_tested.toast_notifications: ✅ Working - Shows 'Dev server iniciado' and 'Dev server detenido' messages
features_tested.access_control: ✅ Working - All dev server endpoints require authentication
features_tested.preview_live_indicator: ⚠️ Missing - No persistent visual indicator when dev server is running
